baseline.question: How many days of paid annual leave are full-time employees entitled to per year?
baseline.answer_preview: Full-time employees are entitled to 15 days of paid annual leave per year [hr_001].

baseline.question: How far in advance must leave be approved by the manager?
baseline.answer_preview: Leave must be approved by the direct manager at least 2 weeks in advance [hr_001].

baseline.question: How many unused leave days can be carried over to the next year?
baseline.answer_preview: Employees can carry over up to 5 days of unused annual leave into the next calendar year [hr_001].

baseline.question: How many days of paid sick leave can employees take annually?
baseline.answer_preview: Employees may take up to 10 days of paid sick leave annually [hr_002].

baseline.question: When is a medical certificate required for sick leave?
baseline.answer_preview: A medical certificate is required for any sick leave exceeding 3 consecutive days [hr_002].
